conclusion: Two ε2 alleles. The lowest APOE-attributable Alzheimer's risk; a minority of carriers develop type III hyperlipoproteinemia.
One ε2 and one ε3. Slightly lower late-onset Alzheimer's risk than ε3/ε3.
One ε2 and one ε4: opposing alleles. The risk is not the sum of its parts and is poorly resolved.
Two ε3 alleles: the reference genotype most risk estimates are expressed against.
One ε4 allele. Higher late-onset Alzheimer's risk than ε3/ε3; penetrance is incomplete and depends on age.
Two ε4 alleles. The highest APOE-attributable late-onset Alzheimer's risk; still not deterministic.
One KL-VS haplotype. On its own it has no clear effect on Alzheimer's risk; its association is with ε4 carriers (see the combination).
